title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (6/20): The Apprentice at the Old Herbal Pharmacy
note_en: Here 才 means "only then, not before": 中药要坚持喝一段时间，效果才会慢慢出现 "you have to keep taking herbal medicine for a while before the effects gradually show." English often says "before" or "only after"; Chinese states the condition first and puts 才 in front of the result, signaling that it comes late or only under that condition.
